title: CVE-2026-124469 — OpenEMR before 8.3.0 SQL Injection via Fee Sheet warehouse parameter
summary: Affected: openemr OpenEMR before 8.3.0 contains an SQL injection vulnerability in the Fee Sheet drug-inventory lookup (DrugSalesService::sellDrug) that interpolates the prod[N][warehouse] POST field into an ORDER BY clause. Low-privileged authenticated users can submit Fee Sheet product lines with constant subqueries to run a time-based blind oracle, extracting patient data and users_secure bcrypt hashes.

title: CVE-2026-124470 — OpenEMR before 8.3.0 BOLA via portal_custom_report.php Exposes Patient Problem Lists
summary: Affected: openemr OpenEMR before 8.3.0 contains a broken object level authorization vulnerability in portal/report/portal_custom_report.php that allows authenticated portal patients to read other patients' problem list entries. Attackers can enumerate sequential IDs in issue_ parameter names to retrieve other patients' problem titles, clinical notes, ICD diagnosis codes, and IPPF contraceptive records.

title: CVE-2026-124471 — OpenEMR before 8.3.0 Missing Authorization and IDOR via sl_eob_invoice.php
summary: Affected: openemr OpenEMR before 8.3.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in interface/billing/sl_eob_invoice.php that allows any authenticated user to read and modify billing data for any encounter. Attackers can iterate the id parameter to read patient names and billing notes, and post payments, adjustments, deletions, or billing notes against any patient's account.

title: CVE-2026-119993 — Microsoft Office Outlook Information Disclosure Vulnerability
summary: Affected: Microsoft 365 Apps for Enterprise, Microsoft Office LTSC 2021, Microsoft Office LTSC 2024 Access of resource using incompatible type ('type confusion') in Microsoft Office Outlook allows an unauthorized attacker to disclose information over a network.

title: CVE-2026-111309 — Microsoft Office Outlook Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
summary: Affected: Microsoft 365 Apps for Enterprise, Microsoft Office LTSC 2021, Microsoft Office LTSC 2024 Release of invalid pointer or reference in Microsoft Office Outlook allows an unauthorized attacker to execute code over a network.

title: CVE-2026-110068 — Microsoft Office Outlook Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
summary: Affected: Microsoft 365 Apps for Enterprise, Microsoft Office 365 for Mac, Microsoft Office LTSC 2021, Microsoft Office LTSC 2024, Microsoft Office LTSC for Mac 2021, Microsoft Office LTSC for Mac 2024 Use after free in Microsoft Office Outlook allows an unauthorized attacker to execute code over a network.

title: CVE-2026-110043 — Microsoft Office Outlook Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
summary: Affected: Microsoft 365 Apps for Enterprise, Microsoft Office LTSC 2021, Microsoft Office LTSC 2024 Heap-based buffer overflow in Microsoft Office Outlook allows an unauthorized attacker to execute code over a network.
